criteria.one_covers_other: One is a broader or later version that fully includes the other's work.
criteria.related_distinct: Same area or feature, but each requires separate work.
criteria.same_work: Both ask for essentially the same change or investigation.
criteria.unrelated: Different areas; doing one says nothing about the other.
